decision_reason: The pulled geometry-keyed policy tree passes a real 32K server request with 2.115 GiB headroom, improves both 512/128 prefill and decode against an in-process pre-geometry policy control, and passes the full natural25 native-B3 no-regression gate. The A/B control is synthetic and the model lacks a separate quality/topline gate, so this result remains diagnostic.

server_32k.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/hipengine serve --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --backend hip_gfx1100 --quant gguf_q4_k_m --max-context-tokens 32768 --max-active-requests 1 --startup-min-free-mib 1024 --port 8018

geometry_policy_ab_512_128.protocol: one warmup plus three measured persistent-session runs; 512 prompt, 128 decode, graph replay; same current source and process environment
geometry_policy_ab_512_128.control_definition: Before model construction, remove QWEN35_DENSE_H5120_GEOMETRY/MOSTLY_Q4_K_M entries from the six maps re-keyed by the geometry-policy commit; this reproduces pre-geometry Qwen3.8 policy misses without changing kernel sources or caches.

mtp_full_natural25.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1100 HIPENGINE_GGUF_DECODE_REPACK=1 HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 scripts/qwen36_dense_gguf_suite.py --model /models/gguf/Qwen3.8-27B-Q4_K_M.gguf --quant gguf_q4_k_m --prompts benchmarks/prompts/mtpbench-code-general-ja.jsonl --max-new-tokens 25 --candidate-budgets 3 --target-verify-mode native --runs 1 --limit 10 --warmup --compiler-version-file /tmp/hipengine-qwen36-27b-single-layout-hipcc-version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/qwen38-xtx-current-full-native-b3.json

limitations: The 512/128 control mutates policy maps in-process and is not a separate clean-tree benchmark revision.
Repeated token 9707 is used only for the fixed-shape direct and capacity controls; MTP economics use the complete natural prompt suite.
This validates one active BF16 server request at 32K. It does not admit higher concurrency or INT8 KV.
